(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  have upd (a b : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then b j else a j) =
        (b i - a i) * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num a := by
    rw [← sub_eq_iff_eq_add, hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [← sub_mul, ite_sub, sub_self, ite_mul, zero_mul,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  have hd := ((hrelation d e).mp h.1).2
  have he := ((hrelation e f).mp h.2).2
  simp_rw [upd] at hd he
  have hs : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d + 9 * digits_to_num d := by
    simpa only [hdigits_to_num, sub_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, Int.nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
      (Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hd i))
  intro i
  apply (IsCoprime.pow_right (n := i.1)
    (show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 from ⟨3, -2, by norm_num⟩)).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  convert dvd_sub (dvd_sub hs (dvd_add (hd i) (he i)))
    (dvd_mul_right (7 : ℤ) (digits_to_num d)) using 1 <;> ring
